title: Delete is disabled and Save shows a spinner while an Edit Library Part save is pending
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-E1 (entry with nothing behind it, so Delete is enabled); note its description. Chrome DevTools Network tab open, throttling set to No throttling to start.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Part Library > open QAPL-E1 > pencil.
  2. DevTools > Network > throttling Slow 3G. Change the Description to "QAPL-E1 slow save" and click Save.
  3. While the request is pending, press Tab until focus reaches Delete (or would), then press Enter.
  4. While still pending, click Save again.
  5. Wait for the response, then set throttling back to No throttling.
  6. Pencil > restore the original description > Save.
custom_expected:
1. "Edit Library Part" opens; Delete and Save are both enabled.
  2. One POST /api/parts-catalogue/change-catalogue-part is pending; Save shows a spinner and Delete is disabled.
  3. Delete cannot be activated: no "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?" question and no POST /api/parts-catalogue/remove-catalogue-part in Network.
  4. No second change-catalogue-part request is sent; the spinner stays on Save.
  5. The request returns 200; the spinner stops and the detail page shows "QAPL-E1 slow save". The entry still exists.
  6. Saved; the original description is back.
